meta.purpose: exp77 §1 enumeration: root x template grid from AraVec vocabulary
meta.route: AraVec-vocabulary scan: every ال-form token analyzed through CAMeL builtin DB; (root, pattern) collected for pos in {noun, adj} with prc0=Al_det; pattern mapped to 6 columns. AraVec attestation = True for all words by construction.
meta.divergence_from_d4_classify: D4's _classify requires rat='r', gen='m', num='s' (human noun convention). exp77 drops that: all pos in {noun, adj} with prc0=Al_det admitted. Verbs (pos='verb') excluded.
meta.pattern_normalization: trailing single haraka stripped before lookup (handles construct/case twins)
meta.weak_flag_definition: root carries at least one '#' radical (CAMeL convention per d4_roots_of_record.json)
meta.geminate_flag_definition: two or more non-'#' radicals are identical (most commonly R2==R3)
meta.ge3_col_rule: roots attested in >=3 of the 6 columns
meta.weak_quota: >=50% of selected roots must be weak_or_geminate
